pricing.details: Official euro prices, excluding VAT. Starter is free for the first 3 months (10 checked questions/month, 1 user), then paid plans start at Essential 79 €/month (66 €/month billed yearly). Professional 199 €/month (166 €/month yearly, 5 users, extra user 19.95 €/month). Compliance 399 €/month (333 €/month yearly, 25 users, extra user 24.95 €/month). Optional API 50 €/month (42 €/month or 500 €/year) and Evidence Engine 250 €/month (209 €/month or 2,500 €/year).
